notices.title: Joint Orem and Vineyard City Council Meeting
notices.agenda_text:
CITY OF OREM CITY COUNCIL MEETING
56 North State Street, Orem, Utah November 17, 2026

This meeting may be held electronically to allow a Councilmember to participate.


12:30 P.M. JOINT OREM/VINEYARD WORK SESSION - CITY COUNCIL CHAMBERS

1.	WORK SESSION ITEMS
While this is a public meeting, we kindly ask that only presenters and individuals specifically invited by the Mayor or City Council speak or ask questions. This helps us conduct the City's business in an efficient and orderly manner. If you would like to make a comment on an issue, please do so during the Public Appearances portion of the regular meeting. This ensures that your comment is properly addressed and documented for the official record. Please keep side conversations to a minimum as it interferes with the audio recording.

1.1	DISCUSSION - Lakeside Park Improvements, Programming Agreement, and Soccer Partnership Summary
Presenter: Bryce Merrill, Orem Community Services Executive Director and Brian Vawdrey, Vineyard Parks and Recreation Director

1.2	DISCUSSION - Shared Streets Agreement for 400 South and 1800 West (Orem) / 620 East (Vineyard)
Presenter: Chris Tschirki, Orem Public Works Executive Director

1.3	DISCUSSION - Safety Improvements on 400 South between Genenva Road and Lakeside Sports Park, including alignment of the intersection of Vineyard Road with 400 South and the entrance to the teacher's parking lot at Vineyard Elementary School
Presenter: Naseem Ghandour, Vineyard City Engineer

1.4	DISCUSSION - Fire and EMS Services
Presenter: Marc Sanderson, Fire Chief

1.5	DISCUSSION - Wakara Way and Orem/Vineyard Trail Connection
Presenter: Ryan Clark, Orem Assistant City Manager

2.	ADJOURN

notices.title: Public Hearing Notice
notices.agenda_text:
NOTICE OF PUBLIC HEARING
The Vineyard City Council will hold public hearings on Tuesday, August 25, 2026, starting at 6:00 PM or as soon thereafter as possible, in the City Council Chambers at 125 South Main Street, Vineyard, Utah, to hear public comment regarding a compensation increase for elective and statutory officials and amendments to the Fiscal Year 2026-2027 Budget.
Any persons having an interest in these matters may attend and be heard during the public hearings. Written comments and requests for copies of materials can be emailed to robinr@vineyardutah.gov prior to the meeting.
The related budget documents can be found on our website at vineyardutah.gov
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, individuals needing special accommodations during this meeting should notify the City Recorder at least 24 hours prior to the meeting by calling (385) 338.5183.
I, the undersigned Deputy City Recorder for Vineyard, Utah, hereby certify that the foregoing Public Notice was posted at the Vineyard City Office, on the Vineyard City website, and on the Utah Public Notice website.
Posted: August 18, 2026
Certified (Noticed) by: /s/ Tony Lara, Deputy City Recorder
